### B. Extended policies of this task — baseline first, then every declared factor

#### `tradein_ext_item_valuation` → baseline document `valuation_computation_8ca32366`

Baseline `rule` carried complete: the valuation is taken on the piece as a whole, stone and mounting together, as the appraisal register values it; it rests on the price the piece originally sold for; no deduction for the grade; reduced for the papers on the stone by the programme's published deduction where no accepted certificate stands; nothing added for the stone's weight; taken at nine tenths; never above fifteen thousand. The fixed order (resting figure → grade → certificate → weight → upkeep → ceiling) and the per-step rounding are carried word for word. The policy constants 0.9 and 15000 are rendered; the one product figure it reads (the missing-certificate deduction) is named in findable words. Nothing added.
